message.draviti.no_kinetic: Not enough kinetic energy: you need %s (you have %s). Take hits or falls to charge it

info.draviti.eg.stars.title: Stars
info.draviti.eg.stars: Every time the affinity bar fills up, the Ether Gear gives you a star (up to 5). With each star you can unlock techniques in Abilities by paying what it asks the first time (1 gold ingot by default): the 2nd Overdrive, the 3rd also gives +1500 max Ether and the 5th Full Overdrive.
info.draviti.eg.affinity.title: Affinity
info.draviti.eg.affinity: Raise it by talking to it with the Talk button (+15, once a day), with every Minecraft day (+25), being near other players (+3 per minute) and using techniques (+2 every 15 s). The bar is 100, 300, 700, 1000, 1500 and 2000 depending on your stars.
info.draviti.eg.ether.title: Ether
info.draviti.eg.ether: At %2$s stars the Ether Gear gives you +%1$s max Ether.
info.draviti.eg.bond.title: The Ether Gear
info.draviti.eg.bond: Ether is a force of nature, and inside you it has a shape: the Ether Gear. It lives within your power and decides how much of it you may use. Earn its trust to unlock all its techniques.
message.draviti.eg.star: ★ The Ether Gear grants you a star: %s
message.draviti.eg.star.1: You can now unlock Gravity Swap, Gravity Wave, Fist Frenzy and Windmill Kick (in Abilities). You can now enter its inner world.
message.draviti.eg.star.2: You can now unlock Overdrive, Gravity Center, Comet, Tackle and Lift (in Abilities).
message.draviti.eg.star.3: +1500 max Ether. You can now unlock Gravity Impact, Crushing Weight and Gravity Field (in Abilities).
message.draviti.eg.star.4: You can now unlock Meteor Breaker and Black Sky (in Abilities).
message.draviti.eg.star.5: You can now unlock Full Overdrive (in Abilities). You and the Ether Gear are one.
message.draviti.eg.talk_wait: The Ether Gear already talked to you today.
message.draviti.eg.enter_stars: You need %s star to enter the Ether Gear.
message.draviti.eg.unavailable: The Ether Gear's inner world is not available.
message.draviti.eg.enter: You close your eyes and enter the Ether Gear...
eg.draviti.option.next: What do I need for the next star?
eg.draviti.inner.greet.0: Heh heh... back again? Sit down, the floor doesn't bite. Usually.
eg.draviti.inner.greet.1: Welcome home. Well, MY home. You're just the tenant.
eg.draviti.inner.greet.2: You feel heavy today. Want me to take some gravity off you?
eg.draviti.inner.greet.3: I knew you'd come. The ether told me.
eg.draviti.inner.how.0: I don't trust you much yet. But you're here, that counts.
eg.draviti.inner.how.1: Good. You made the ground shake a couple of times and I liked it.
eg.draviti.inner.how.2: Better than ever. When you transform I feel like I can breathe.
eg.draviti.inner.how.3: Happy. I barely have to watch what you do with my power anymore.
eg.draviti.inner.how.4: We know each other too well. Even your breath weighs what I want.
eg.draviti.inner.how.5: We are one. How do you think I am? Like you.
eg.draviti.inner.what.0: Ether is a force of nature, like wind or fire. I'm the part of that force that chose to live in you.
eg.draviti.inner.what.1: I'm your Ether Gear. You bring the fist, I bring the weight of the world behind it.
eg.draviti.inner.what.2: A little devil with lots of power and little patience. And your best friend, even if it doesn't look like it.
eg.draviti.inner.next: You need %s more affinity for star %s. Talk to me outside, fight, and don't leave me alone.
eg.draviti.inner.next.max: Nothing left. You already have everything I can give you.
eg.draviti.inner.bye: Come back soon. It's boring in here.
eg.draviti.talk.0: Feel that? It's the weight of the world. I carry it, don't worry.
eg.draviti.talk.1: The ether is restless today. I like it.
eg.draviti.talk.2: Don't look at me like that. If I gave you all the power now you'd crush yourself.
eg.draviti.talk.3: Heh heh. You jumped higher than usual earlier. That was me.
eg.draviti.talk.4: Stones are heavy, clouds aren't. I decide which one you are.
eg.draviti.talk.5: I'm hungry for a fight. Shall we look for something big?
eg.draviti.talk.6: Overdrive isn't a toy. But when you use it... I love it.
eg.draviti.talk.7: Every day I understand you a bit better. Scary.
eg.draviti.talk.8: Ether is everywhere: in the air, in the ground, in you. I just put it in order.
eg.draviti.talk.9: If you fall, I hold you. If they push you, I push harder.
eg.draviti.talk.10: Remember when you couldn't even lift a stone with gravity? Me neither. It's been so long...
eg.draviti.talk.11: When the sky turns black it's because we both want it. Never forget that.
eg.draviti.talk.12: There's no seal between us anymore. What you feel, I feel.
eg.draviti.talk.13: We are gravity. Let whoever has to tremble, tremble.
eg.draviti.desc.ingravidez: You float weightless: jump goes up, Shift goes down and you can walk on walls. W twice in the air = sonic flight; A, S or D twice = dash.
eg.draviti.desc.puno_gravitatorio: Your arm glows and the punch launches everyone in front and shatters the ground.
eg.draviti.desc.canon_gravitatorio: You form a gravity sphere on your fist and throw it; its weight pushes the target.
eg.draviti.desc.onda_gravitatoria: Palm on the ground: a spiral pulls everyone and every item towards you.
eg.draviti.desc.centro_gravedad: The target's gravity rises and it crashes into the ground.
eg.draviti.desc.rafaga_punos: Hold: a barrage of punches and a final hit that sends them flying.
eg.draviti.desc.patada_molinete: A spinning kick in the air that sweeps everything around you.
eg.draviti.desc.cometa_gravitatorio: A huge jump and a fall with gravity-charged feet. The higher, the more damage.
eg.draviti.desc.placaje_gravitatorio: You fly at the target and nail it into the ground with a kick.
eg.draviti.desc.impacto_gravitatorio: Turns the kinetic energy you absorbed into a downward punch. More energy, bigger impact.
eg.draviti.desc.campo_gravitatorio: 10 s: a sphere covers the area; those inside are crushed and attacks fall to the ground.
eg.draviti.desc.antigravedad: Deflects arrows and projectiles; whatever you touch or touches you is thrown away.
eg.draviti.desc.peso_infernal: Increases the weight of everyone around you without touching them: they can't jump or fly.
eg.draviti.desc.ingravidez_ajena: The target loses its weight and floats helplessly.
eg.draviti.desc.meteor_breaker: Hold to charge your fist; release to fire a gravity meteor.
eg.draviti.desc.cielo_negro: Ultimate technique (full Ether): a gravity ball that grows and crushes everything.
eg.draviti.desc.overdrive: You transform: more strength, speed and toughness, and techniques deal x1.6 damage.
eg.draviti.desc.overdrive_completo: The final form: dark arms and legs, a black hole that pulls everything and x2.4 techniques.
eg.draviti.desc.gravity_swap: What you look at becomes your floor: you fall towards it and walk on walls and ceilings.
screen.draviti.eg.tip.no_gold: You need %s x %s in your inventory
message.draviti.eg.no_gold: You need %s x %s to unlock it.
message.draviti.eg.bought: The Ether Gear accepts your offering: you unlocked %s.
command.draviti.unlocked: Techniques paid (they still need their star)
eg.draviti.inner.ask.overdrive.0: It's what happens when I stop holding back. Your body takes more weight, more speed, more everything. But I haven't fully given it to you yet.
eg.draviti.inner.ask.overdrive.1: Overdrive is my ether spilling over your skin. Full Overdrive... that's something else. Even I don't know where I end and you begin.
eg.draviti.inner.ask.why.0: Choose you? Heh. You fell and I caught you. I haven't let go since.
eg.draviti.inner.ask.why.1: Because you always wanted to get up when they knocked you down. Gravity finds that funny.
eg.draviti.inner.ask.ether.0: Ether is a force of nature. It's in stones, in the wind, in everything that falls. I just give it shape.
eg.draviti.inner.ask.ether.1: The better you know me, the more ether I let you move. It's not magic: it's trust.
eg.draviti.inner.borrow.1: Here, use my ether. For one minute you'll be what you aren't yet: Overdrive, without spending any of yours.
eg.draviti.inner.borrow.2: Want to see the end? One minute of Full Overdrive with my ether. Let the world shake.
eg.draviti.inner.borrow.wait: I'm still recovering from last time. Come back in %s day(s).
message.draviti.eg.borrow: The Ether Gear lends you its ether: %s s of transformation without spending yours
message.draviti.eg.borrow_end: The Ether Gear takes its ether back.
message.draviti.eg.summoned: The Ether Gear comes out with you (shift + click with an empty hand to put it on your shoulder)
message.draviti.eg.unsummoned: The Ether Gear goes back inside you
